title: Pro-Pashinyan support rally during rival demonstrations
reason: The report identifies several hundred people staging a pro-Pashinyan rally but records no demand directed at the Armenian government or state policy; available evidence describes support for the incumbent rather than an anti-state demand.
notes: Not treated as an eligible anti-state mobilization without evidence of a qualifying government-directed demand. This is not an inference that the event was small; RFE/RL reports several hundred participants.

title: Hadrut residents’ march to Russian and planned US embassies in Yerevan
reason: The reviewed account directs requests for restored/de-occupied Hadrut and a meeting to Russian/US diplomatic representatives; it supplies no demand directed to Armenia’s government or policy. Attendance is unreported. Not coded as qualifying domestic-state mobilization on available evidence.
notes: NEWS.am reports a public march in Yerevan and a letter accepted by a Russian Embassy representative. This is a source-bounded eligibility screen, not proof no other contemporaneous action by these residents targeted Armenia’s state.
